official_source.revision: June 2023; printed pp. 45–47. FM9-family guide; firmware downloads checked 2026-11-24.

completed_checkpoints.documented_controls: Touch-Ladder is the Ladder filter controlled by playing, with Touch-Wah envelope controls in place of Frequency/LFO: Start/Stop Frequency (100 Hz–10 kHz), Sweep Shape, Detector Source (block or physical input), Sensitivity, Attack, Release, and Emphasis. Physical-input detector routing is unavailable. Project scales, envelope mapping, nonlinear cascade, feedback, shelf behavior, and DSP do not claim Fractal parity.

verification.browser: make web-test-stereo-filter verified Touch-Ladder controls at Stereo Filter ID 96 in Filters & wah; the following checkpoint also tests the Touch-Ladder configuration.
verification.notes: No Fractal DSP/settings parity, device test, or human listening result.
